command:
set -eu
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'SERVICE='; rc-service postgresql status
printf 'ENABLED='; rc-update show default | grep -q postgresql && printf 'yes\n'
printf 'SOURCE_SHA256='; sha256sum /srv/legacy2/postgresql-sequence-repair/tickets.sql
printf 'DATABASE='; sudo -u postgres -- psql -d helpdesk -Atc "SELECT current_database();"
printf 'IMPORTED_ROWS:\n'; sudo -u postgres -- psql -d helpdesk -P pager=off -c "SELECT id, subject FROM tickets ORDER BY id;"
printf 'SEQUENCE_BEFORE_TEST:\n'; sudo -u postgres -- psql -d helpdesk -P pager=off -c "SELECT last_value, is_called FROM tickets_id_seq;"
printf 'AUTO_ID_TEST_ROLLED_BACK:\n'; sudo -u postgres -- psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d helpdesk -P pager=off -c "BEGIN; INSERT INTO tickets(subject) VALUES ('sequence verification') RETURNING id, subject; ROLLBACK;"
sudo -u postgres -- psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d helpdesk -c "SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('tickets','id'), (SELECT MAX(id) FROM tickets), true);" >/dev/null
printf 'FINAL_STATE:\n'; sudo -u postgres -- psql -d helpdesk -P pager=off -c "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tickets) AS row_count, (SELECT max(id) FROM tickets) AS max_id, last_value, is_called FROM tickets_id_seq;"
